test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no improvement required, select ‘No improvement’.

Some students think that if they cram a few chapters, they can __pass in the exam.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **'pass in the exam'** is incorrect. The correct phrase is **'pass the exam'**.
 
• In English, we use the verb "**pass" **directly with the object** "exam"** without any preposition in between.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1: pass the exam**.

 

Hence, the correct statement is '*Some students think that if they cram a few chapters, they can **pass the exam**.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In English grammar, certain phrases and verbs have specific prepositions or no prepositions at all. It's important to know these standard usages to avoid errors.
 
 
• **Example:** *He **passed the test** with flying colors.*
 
 
 
• Always check for idiomatic expressions and standard verb-object combinations to ensure correct usage.
